reviews.author: Martin Nowak
reviews.text: Jeremy was able to come a week early to install my mini split in the garage, now my man cave will be nice and cool in the summer and I will not have to use a kerosene heater in the winter. He did an excellent job

reviews.author: chasity miles
reviews.text: Our upstairs unit froze up 2 days in a row. Called to see when someone could come out and take a look. Jeremy came out same day and got our unit back to working correctly. Can’t thank him enough for making time for us and fixing the problem in the same day. We will be using him to replace our units and for any future problems. I will highly recommend to everybody in need of HVAC services! A gentleman and very professional!

reviews.author: CatrinnaB
reviews.text: Think twice before hiring this company and always get a second opinion. I called this company because my AC was not cooling properly. The technician diagnosed the issue and attempted to connect a compressor while I stood there and watched. Afterward, I was told the compressor was not the problem, the unit still would not work, and the compressor was disconnected before the technician left. Later, I received a text stating that additional repairs totaling approximately $2,100 were needed to fix what was supposedly wrong with my system. Because I was concerned about the diagnosis, I contacted another HVAC company for a second opinion the very same day. That technician connected a compressor, and my AC unit started working immediately. As a homeowner, it was frustrating to be told that the compressor was not the issue and that I needed over $2,000 in additional repairs, only to have another company get the unit running by connecting a compressor. I can only speak to my own experience, but based on what happened, I strongly recommend getting a second opinion before approving expensive HVAC.

reviews.author: Otis Moore
reviews.text: Brian was AWESOME! My wife said that he was very thorough and professional. I wasn’t at home I was taking care of something else. My wife did call me on my way home and said that the upstairs unit wasn’t running. I called Brian and asked him to go back to our house and he did. He returned and as he was leaving, I arrived home and talked to him for a minute. He explained everything to me and stated that he was going to have to order a Zoom Board and would let me know the price and when he could come back for install. He just texted me and stated that he’s coming back out on Saturday morning at 9 am. Cost of parts, labor, and testing fees is $600. Brian is an AWESOME technician. I like him a lot! Thanks Jeremy for sending Brian on this Veteran’s Day!!

reviews.author: Derek McKay
reviews.text: Grovatt Mechanical again for the win - they beat every quote I got from other companies (SIGNIFICANTLY) and his team did amazing work. My downstairs HVAC (3-ton Trane package unit) completely failed after 21 years and the ducting under the house was a mess: too small diameter and didn't meet unit CFM requirements, no insulation to protect both the equipment and the underneath of the house from condensation build-up and moisture intrusion that robs system efficiency, improperly sealed ducting-to-vents, no cut-off switch to the system!!!...list things that can be wrong with an HVAC install and our previous system checked the boxes. Jeremy set us up with a new 3-ton Trane package unit and all new ducting under the house. You'd think, "Output would/should be similar to what it was before since the units are the same size", right? Absolutely not! This new setup pushes more than double the air volume into the house than the last and even on a 90-degree day (yesterday's temperature) knocked the temperature in the house, which had climbed to 77 degrees during the install, down to 72 degrees within the hour. The last setup would basically run all day just to maintain the desired temperature in the house above 85 degrees outside and absolutely could not maintain temperature at 90+ degrees. Grovatt Mechanical came through just in time for summer to hit and I'm looking forward to seeing how this new unit not only maintains a more comfortable home during the hot/cold months, but how much it saves on the electric bill. Don't hesitate to give Jeremy and his team a chance to square your HVAC needs away...they're awesome!
